description: This file defines a PHP interface 'Mail' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Mail'. It specifies method signatures for retrieving email components such as recipients, subject, body, and content type, intended to be implemented by classes representing email messages in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: Mail
classes.description: An interface defining methods for accessing email components like recipient lists, subject, body, and content type.

methods.name: getToList
methods.description: Returns a list of recipient email addresses.

methods.name: getCcList
methods.description: Returns a list of CC recipient email addresses or null if none.

methods.name: getBccList
methods.description: Returns a list of BCC recipient email addresses or null if none.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the email subject or null.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the email body content or null.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the MIME content type of the email or null.
